A5-111.axis: sub-types (named contemporary tendencies) first; then artists by named group or circle (Neo-Geo, New Leipzig School, New Glasgow Boys, Chinese groups from the Stars to Cynical Realism, Indigenous and diaspora movements); then by country of activity, largest first, split by birth generation where a country exceeds 150; countries with fewer than 3 artists pooled by region; artists with no recorded country grouped by the biennial or list that recorded them; within groups by birth year
A5-111.defn: The period style of painters and artists born from about 1945 who work after modernism in plural, global practices: post-colonial figurative painting, new abstraction, appropriation, art of the biennial circuit. Artists who belong to a named post-1945 movement (Neo-expressionism, Young British Artists, Pictures Generation, Superflat, Stuckism...) sit in that movement's leaf; this leaf keeps the rest.
